title: Build the AI Expense Watchdog Premium Blueprint (private preview)
objective:
Build the Premium Blueprint described in agent-specs/ai-expense-watchdog.json. Read that spec, agents/standards.md, and AGENTS.md first.
Create the public guided demo at /blueprints/ai-expense-watchdog and the signed-in Premium kit at /blueprints/ai-expense-watchdog/kit.
Kit contents: Expense Review Setup Checklist; Recurring Ledger Prompt; Price Change and Overlap Prompt; Keep List and Overlap Rules Worksheet; Recurring Ledger Template; Cancel Review Checklist; Fictional Sample Card Export; Data and Safety Guidance.
Follow every entry in the spec's constraints list.
Do not commit, push, merge, deploy, or publish.
acceptance_criteria: GET /blueprints/ai-expense-watchdog without a session renders a page whose h1 is 'AI Expense Watchdog', with a visible 'Private preview' label.
The guided demo page's HTML contains a robots meta tag whose content includes 'noindex' and 'nofollow'.
The guided demo page shows the fictional data notice text exactly as specified in guided_demo.fictional_data_notice, above the first demo step.

The guided demo is a six-step stepper. It shows the text 'Step N of 6', a 'Next step' button (absent or disabled on step 6), and a 'Previous step' button (absent or disabled on step 1). Each step has a visible heading.

Step 1 shows a table with exactly 10 data rows whose vendor names include DesignHub Pro, CanvaLite Teams, ZoomMeet, and Harbor Office Supply. It also shows '2026-07-01 to 2026-09-30', '2026-09-30', 'ZoomMeet', 'design tools', and '5.00'.

Step 2 shows the exact heading 'RECURRING LEDGER FIRST'. DesignHub Pro, CanvaLite Teams, and ZoomMeet are listed as recurring. Harbor Office Supply is listed as NOT RECURRING with text containing '84.00' and 'one charge'. ZoomMeet is listed as skipped for cancel review.

Step 3 shows ledger text '=39.00-29.00' and '10.00' on DesignHub Pro, '=30.00-30.00' and '0.00' on CanvaLite Teams, and '=15.99-15.99' and '0.00' on ZoomMeet. It shows the text labels 'CONFIRMED', 'AI INTERPRETATION', and 'RECOMMENDED ACTION' as visible words, not as color or icon alone. The AI INTERPRETATION line contains 'may overlap' and 'not a savings figure'. The RECOMMENDED ACTION line contains 'confirm who uses' and 'Do not cancel from a guess.'.

Step 4 shows the DesignHub Pro CONFIRMED line with 29.00 and 39.00. Activating 'Check facts against the export row' reveals three rows (2026-07-03, 2026-08-03, 2026-09-03), each containing the text 'Matches', and the values 29.00, 39.00, and 39.00.
Step 5 shows 'No new export was provided.', 'no usage column', ZoomMeet on the keep list, and the sentence 'Re-run next month with a new export. Do not cancel from a guess.'.

Step 6 contains the exact sentences 'You cancel it. The kit changes nothing.' and 'Do not cancel from a guess.' and a link to /blueprints/ai-expense-watchdog/kit whose visible text says sign-in is required and the kit is a private preview.
Every vendor name, date, and amount in the demo matches the guided_demo.sample_input rows and sample_output exactly.

Neither page contains the text 'checkout', 'buy now', 'purchase', 'Buy Premium', '/month', or 'per month'. The only dollar figures are the fictional export amounts and the confirmed difference (29.00, 39.00, 30.00, 15.99, 84.00, 10.00, 5.00).
Neither page contains a percentage, an hours-saved figure, a 'you could save' claim, or an ROI or savings-total claim.
The homepage (/) and the site header contain zero links whose href includes '/blueprints/ai-expense-watchdog', and /sitemap.xml does not contain '/blueprints/ai-expense-watchdog'.
GET /blueprints/ai-expense-watchdog/kit without a session redirects to /auth with the query parameter next=/blueprints/ai-expense-watchdog/kit.

AI Expense Watchdog is registered in src/lib/blueprints.ts with id and productSlug 'ai-expense-watchdog', access 'premium', href '/blueprints/ai-expense-watchdog/kit', purchaseHref '/blueprints/ai-expense-watchdog', and badge PREMIUM. It is not added to PAID_PRODUCTS and has no Stripe price.

The kit page calls requireUser('/blueprints/ai-expense-watchdog/kit') from src/lib/auth.ts and hasActiveEntitlement(user.id, 'ai-expense-watchdog') from src/lib/payments/access.ts. It exports metadata with robots { index: false, follow: false }.

With an authenticated entitled session, the kit page renders h1 'AI Expense Watchdog Premium Kit' and the exact label text 'Premium · Private preview'. Kit resource and interaction criteria below apply only to this entitled state.

With an authenticated session that has no AI Expense Watchdog entitlement, the kit page renders h1 'Premium is locked', does not render kit content sections such as #setup-checklist, and does not show a Buy Premium button or a Stripe price.

The kit page shows 8 resource sections with headings matching the kit_contents titles, each with an element id equal to its kit_contents id. A table of contents at the top links to each section with an href of '#<id>'.

The Recurring Ledger Prompt is shown in a <pre> element and contains these strings: 'RECURRING LEDGER FIRST', 'CONFIRMED', 'AI INTERPRETATION', 'RECOMMENDED ACTION', 'two months', 'Do not cancel', 'Do not invent', 'Do not claim savings', 'unused', 'You cancel it'.

The Price Change and Overlap Prompt is shown in a <pre> element and contains: 'only after', 'ledger', 'price change', 'overlap', 'not a savings figure', 'Do not cancel', 'Do not invent', 'You cancel it'.

Each prompt has a 'Copy Prompt' button that writes the exact <pre> text to the clipboard and changes its label to 'Copied'. If the clipboard is unavailable, it shows a visible error telling the person to copy manually.

The Keep List and Overlap Rules Worksheet has a visible label 'Essential vendors to never flag for cancel (one per line)' whose default value is 'ZoomMeet', a visible label 'Overlap-watch categories (one per line)' whose default value is 'design tools', a visible label 'Minimum amount to list as a price change (USD)' whose default value is '5', plus a 'Generate My Expense Review Rules' button.

With the defaults, the generated rules block contains 'Always keep: ZoomMeet.', 'Watch for overlap in: design tools.', 'List a price change only when the later amount minus the earlier amount is 5.00 or more.', 'Group a vendor as recurring only when it appears in at least two months.', 'One-time charges are not subscriptions.', 'Do not invent savings.', and 'Do not cancel. You cancel it. The kit changes nothing.' The block has a Copy button.
If the minimum-amount field is empty or negative, the worksheet shows the error 'Enter a minimum amount of 0 or more.' and generates no rules block.

When 'Essential vendors to never flag for cancel (one per line)' is empty, the generated rules block contains no 'Always keep' line. When it contains 'ZoomMeet' and 'Harbor Office Supply' on two lines, the block contains 'Always keep: ZoomMeet; Harbor Office Supply.'.

The Recurring Ledger Template shows the columns vendor, jul, aug, sep, cadence, change_formula, change_result, keep_list. Its 'Copy CSV' button writes text whose first line is 'vendor,jul,aug,sep,cadence,change_formula,change_result,keep_list' and whose DesignHub Pro row contains '29.00', '39.00', '=39.00-29.00', and '10.00'.

The Cancel Review Checklist shows 9 checkbox items with visible labels, a progress line 'Checked N of 9', and a 'Reset checklist' button that sets the count back to 0. Progress is not saved beyond the browser session.
The Fictional Sample Card Export section is labelled 'Fictional' and its Copy CSV text equals the date,vendor,amount,source rows and header from guided_demo.sample_input.
The Setup Checklist and the Data and Safety Guidance sections each state that file upload support and data controls in ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini differ by plan, account, and admin settings.
The kit page says that worksheet entries and checklist progress stay in this browser session and are not saved to Atlas.
With an authenticated entitled session, /my-blueprints shows the AI Expense Watchdog card as Unlocked with an Open Blueprint link to /blueprints/ai-expense-watchdog/kit.

With an authenticated session that has no AI Expense Watchdog entitlement, /my-blueprints shows the AI Expense Watchdog card as Locked with an Available to purchase link to /blueprints/ai-expense-watchdog and no link to the kit.

With an authenticated session, /my-blueprints still shows the free Daily Inbox Starter Kit with Open Starter Kit pointing at /blueprints/daily-inbox-briefing/starter-kit. AI Collections Assistant entitlement, Buy Premium, and checkout behavior are unchanged. Security Readiness Action Pack, Google Ads Performance Coach, and Quote Request Assistant entitlement and locked or unlocked card behavior are unchanged.

At a 393px-wide viewport, neither page scrolls horizontally (document scrollWidth minus clientWidth is 1px or less) on any demo step or kit section. Tables either wrap or scroll inside their own container.

Every interactive control on both pages can be reached with Tab and activated with Enter or Space, and shows a visible focus ring. After 'Next step' or 'Previous step', focus moves to the new step's heading.
Loading both pages produces no unexpected browser console errors or page errors, as judged by the e2e/support/fixtures.ts console filter.

Product implementation files live under app/blueprints/ai-expense-watchdog/, components/premium/ai-expense-watchdog/, and src/lib/premium/ai-expense-watchdog/. The Blueprint registry entry lives in src/lib/blueprints.ts. e2e/ai-expense-watchdog/authenticated.spec.ts is the protected acceptance test and must not be weakened, skipped, rewritten, or have assertions removed.

Authenticated QA uses the repository's automatic Playwright session refresh. If the session cannot be refreshed, QA stops with AUTH_SESSION_REFRESH_REQUIRED and that failure is not treated as a product defect.
The guided demo at /blueprints/ai-expense-watchdog renders without sign-in on desktop and a phone-sized viewport, uses only fictional data, and says so.
The kit at /blueprints/ai-expense-watchdog/kit requires sign-in, is labelled Premium · Private preview, and shows no price, checkout, or purchase claim.
Both pages set robots noindex and are not linked from the homepage, header, or sitemap.
Confirmed facts, AI interpretation, and recommended actions are labelled separately, and every external action stays with the person.
The Daily Inbox Briefing, its Starter Kit, and its tests are unchanged.
